title: The unused room
_note: Locked dialogue from docs/VERTICAL_SLICE_SCRIPT.md. Arabic lives here, never in C++ source. Plays after both UnusedBed and ScarOil are examined. EvanSuspicious is the conclusion, not the examine.

lines.speaker: Evan
lines.en: The sheet is tight. He did not lie down.

lines.speaker: Evan
lines.en: Raynor sleeps like a soldier. He would have left a ruin if he had meant to sleep an hour.
lines.ar: رينور ينام كجندي. لو نوى النوم ساعة واحدة لترك خرابًا.

lines.speaker: Evan
lines.en: He oils the scar when the wind is dry. The stopper is loose. The oil is full.
lines.ar: يدهن الندبة حين تجفّ الريح. السدادة مرتخية. الزيت ممتلئ.

lines.speaker: Evan
lines.en: He did not leave. He was taken, or he was lied about.
lines.ar: لم يرحل. إمّا أُخذ، وإمّا كُذب عنه.
